description:
FILED s515c (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-11) from the JSON-PP-4.18-0 board census.

perl 5.36+ has STABLE BOOLEANS: `!!1` / `!!0` (and every comparison result) carry a boolean flag that survives copies, and builtin::is_bool reports it; JSON::PP 4.x encodes such a value as `true`/`false` (perl >= 5.36) and its core_bools option decodes to them.

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3 vs main 973bdb1d):
    no warnings;
    my $t = !!1;
    print builtin::is_bool($t) ? 1 : 0, builtin::is_bool(1) ? 1 : 0, "\n";   # perl 10   PCL 00
    use JSON::PP; print JSON::PP::encode_json([!!1, !!0]), "\n";          # perl [true,false]   PCL [1,""]

PCL has no boolean representation: `pl-!` returns 1 / "" (docs/not-supported.md "Interned boolean constants" covers only the IDENTITY half, s337).  A representation question (the #1391 / #2955 family: no per-value flags) -- needs a ruling (e.g. two interned boolean values the comparison operators return, kept through a copy) before any work.

ROWS (JSON-PP-4.18-0, s515c board): core_bools.t 9 (is_bool / core_bools), 003_types.t 2 (`encode_json [!!1]` / `[!!0]`), 118_boolean_values.t 4 (probable: the boolean_values / JSON::PP::Boolean class rows).

PARKED FOR A FABLE DESIGN (s516, 2026-10-12): a boolean that survives copies is a BOX-MODEL decision (a third raw value kind beside the number and the string, or a flag on the box; every truthiness / stringification / numification site and the raw-slot optimizer are touched), not an Opus brief member.  The s516b brief says: do NOT start it.  JSON-PP's 15 blessed rows stay under this task until the design exists.

DESIGNED s516 (Fable, 2026-10-12): docs/stable-booleans-design-s516.md -- two interned strings +p-yes+ / +p-no+ returned by the ONE p-bool helper (p-!, p-defined, p-exists*, p-sub-exists, the two comparison macro families route through it), builtin::is_bool = identity, builtin::true/false return them; two eq fast arms (p-true-p, %to-number-raw) keep the counting idiom in the bench band; the struct and box-flag alternatives rejected (section 7).  Section 6 is the brief's bar: perl-compared guard rows over every producer / non-producer / copy / loss shape, JSON::PP encode/decode with the core 4.16 and the dist's 4.18, bench rows boolsum + boolif, the 15 JSON-PP rows leave the blessed file.  NO LONGER parked for a design: it can be a correctness-brief member (runtime + guards + docs, one member).

=== DONE (s517a, member 1, commit 76cad49d, 2026-10-15) ===
Built per docs/stable-booleans-design-s516.md (status line updated, §4 carries
the measurements).  Runtime: +p-yes+ / +p-no+ (sb-ext:defglobal, exported);
p-bool moved before p-defined / p-true-p and returns them; routed through it:
p-defined, p-!, p-not (via p-!), p-xor, p-!~, p-isa + %p-isa-mro, p-isweak,
re::is_regexp, Internals::SvREADONLY getter, scalar stat (the comparison
macros and p-exists* already used p-bool).  builtin::true/false return the
objects, is_bool = eq after one unbox, created_as_number/_string false for a
boolean (perl 0,0).  Fast arms: p-true-p string arm head (eq, eq) -- placed in
the string arm, so numbers pay nothing; %to-number-raw (eq -> 1 / 0).
Compiler: `use builtin qw(true false inf nan)` registers their () prototype --
`(1, true, false)` was read as the strings "true"/"false" (pre-existing).
Producer table AS PERL 5.40.3 ANSWERS (is_bool): BOOL = ! not, == != < > <= >=,
eq ne lt gt le ge, defined, exists (hash/array/&sub), isa, true, false,
is_bool, xor, !~, is_weak, re::is_regexp, SvREADONLY, scalar stat (incl. a
failed stat ""), filetests with a successful stat, eof, scalar m//, a failed
s///, utf8::is_utf8 / valid, wantarray, defined &f.  NOT: && || // <=> cmp,
scalar grep, delete, -s, a matching s/// (count), tr (count), a failed-stat
filetest (undef).  PCL routes all but the residue in #3322.
Guards: Pl/t/stable-bool-01.t 9 rows (7 fail on dc87c403; the non-producer
and loss rows pass there by construction).  Mutation probe (tr, s///, chop,
4-arg/lvalue substr, vec, x=, .=, foreach alias, lc) leaves a fresh !!1 / !!0
intact = perl.  JSON-PP: core_bools.t 24/0 (was 14/10); 003_types.t rows 30/31
pass; 11 rows left the blessed board file; 118_boolean_values.t 6/7/10/11 are
#3321 (stash alias), not booleans.  Raw-numeric finding in design §4.
Bench boolsum / boolif: see the s517a STOP.md / session-log.
subject: perl 5.36+ STABLE BOOLEANS are absent: builtin::is_bool(!!1) is false and JSON::PP encodes !!1 / !!0 as 1 / "" where perl writes true / false (JSON-PP core_bools.t 9 rows, 003_types.t 2, 118_boolean_values.t 4)
